description: Chartura Wave Significance Table is a purpose-built matrix visual for market researchers, insights teams, and analysts who need to surface statistically significant differences across tracking study waves - right inside Power BI. Built-in Significance Testing Stop relying on external calculations. Chartura Wave Significance Table performs T-Test and Z-Test significance testing natively, comparing counts against a base measure at 90%, 95%, or 99% confidence levels. Results surface directly in the cell using your choice of seven display styles: arrows, dot indicators, cell fill, bordered cell fill, underline, side rail, or delta pill each fully color-customizable. Flexible Matrix Structure Place any combination of dimensions on rows and columns, with full drill-down and expand/collapse support at every hierarchy level. Row and column subtotals can be configured independently per level, and a grand table total is available with its own distinct styling. Presentation-Ready Formatting Every element of the table - column headers, row headers, data cells, row totals, column totals, table totals, and footer has independent typography controls (font family, size, bold, italic, underline, color).
